item.title: ‘Worst of the worst’: ICE arrests criminal illegal aliens, including a Pakistani — who are they?
item.description: ICE has arrested several undocumented immigrants with serious criminal convictions across multiple states. The individuals, from Guatemala, Mexico, and Pakistan, were convicted of crimes including rape of a minor, aggravated assault, domestic violence, drug offenses, and alien smuggling. These arrests highlight ICE's focus on removing dangerous individuals from communities.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘We turned off the money spigot’: HHS freezes Minnesota child care funds. But why?
item.description: The US Department of Health and Human Services has halted all child care payments to Minnesota, citing widespread fraud. Millions in taxpayer funds are alleged to have been diverted to fake daycares. A new system now requires justification and evidence for all payments nationwide. An investigation into a learning center receiving $4 million with no activity has surfaced.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Oriental Asians': Alex Jones claims Indians have higher crime rates than White
item.description: Far-right commentator Alex Jones claimed Indians have a higher crime rate than Whites, particularly for fraud, despite stating he doesn't hate India. He also asserted that Indians have taken over job sectors in the US, suggesting their mindset is incompatible with American culture.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Physiognomy is real’: Far-right influencers Nick Fuentes and Clavicular swoon over Gavin Newsom’s looks
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom has unexpectedly become a figure of admiration on the far-right, not for his policies, but for his appearance. Figures like Nick Fuentes and streamer Clavicular have praised Newsom's looks, even stating they would hypothetically support him over political opponents based on aesthetics alone.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Cancer, motherhood and RFK Jr’s policies: What Tatiana Schlossberg revealed in her final 'New Yorker' essay?
item.description: Tatiana Schlossberg, daughter of Caroline Kennedy, passed away at 35 after a battle with acute myeloid leukemia. Diagnosed last year, she underwent extensive treatments, including stem cell transplants. In a poignant essay, she voiced concerns about policies impacting cancer research and patients, particularly those championed by her cousin, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Her passing leaves a profound void.

item.title: ‘Calling H-1B workers ‘invaders’ is political theatre’: Viral post slams Florida governor on workforce data
item.description: A social media post challenges Florida Governor Ron DeSantis' immigration stance, refuting his 'invaders' label for H-1B workers. Citing workforce data, the post argues these skilled professionals fill critical labor gaps in Florida's booming economy, particularly in tech and healthcare. It emphasizes the visa program's strict regulations, countering the notion of open borders and highlighting the need for such talent.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Popeyes launches limited time streamer inspired build your own bundles featuring top Twitch creators
item.description: Popeyes is offering a unique "Streamer Build Your Own Bundles" promotion in 2025, allowing customers to customize meals inspired by popular online streamers. Available for a limited time via pickup, these bundles start at $20 and let fans select sides and proteins based on their favorite creators' tastes, blending pop culture with delicious food.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Who was Tatiana Schlossberg? John F Kennedy's granddaughter dead at 35 due to cancer
item.description: Tatiana Schlossberg, President John F. Kennedy's youngest granddaughter, has passed away at 35 after a battle with a rare form of leukemia. Diagnosed shortly after the birth of her second child, she bravely underwent extensive treatments. A Yale and Oxford graduate, Schlossberg was a published author and former journalist, leaving behind her husband and two young children.

item.title: MAGA civil war gets messier as Laura Loomer drags MTG with viral Trump cutout video over ‘sexualization’ accusations
item.description: Far-right commentator Laura Loomer has escalated her public feud with Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene by releasing a video of Greene with a Donald Trump cardboard cutout. Loomer accused Greene of being a "total fraud" following Greene's criticism of "Mar-a-Lago face" and women's presentation in the Republican orbit.

item.title: Who were sanctioned? Inside Washington’s crackdown on Venezuela-Iran’s weapons supply chain
item.description: The US has targeted ten individuals and firms from Iran and Venezuela with sanctions, accusing them of aiding Iran's drone and ballistic missile programs. These measures aim to bolster UN sanctions on Iran's nuclear activities.

item.title: 'I like him': Who is Louis Prevost? Why does Trump love Pope’s brother?
item.description: President Trump hosted Pope Leo's brother, Louis Prevost, at Mar-a-Lago, praising him and referencing a "MAGA" house picture. Prevost, a self-described "MAGA type," has a history of pro-Trump social media posts, including offensive remarks about Nancy Pelosi and calls for arresting Democrats.

item.title: Before Amazon, there was Toni Morrison: The mentor behind MacKenzie Scott’s $19 billion philanthropy
item.description: Toni Morrison's mentorship profoundly shaped MacKenzie Scott's confidence and early career, influencing her path to Amazon and her current philanthropic approach. Scott has since donated over $19 billion, with a significant focus on Historically Black Colleges and Universities, echoing Morrison's lifelong commitments.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Extreme attempt to ‘get high’: Woman injects black widow venom and ends up in ICU
item.description: A rare and deliberate exposure to black widow venom sent a 37-year-old woman to intensive care after she injected a ground-up spider into her bloodstream to get high. Doctors documented severe muscle pain, breathing distress and cardiovascular symptoms, likely intensified by an allergic reaction and an unusually high venom dose. The patient recovered after several days of supportive treatment.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: “Just retire”: Candace Owens fires back at Alex Jones over deep state claims and Charlie Kirk killing debate
item.description: Candace Owens and Alex Jones are locked in a public feud after Jones accused her of working for powerful government groups. Owens rejected the claims and challenged him to show proof. The clash is tied to disagreements over Charlie Kirk’s killing. No evidence has been confirmed, and tensions inside conservative media continue to grow.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Is Belle Delphine alive? YouTuber death claim spreads after viral tweet resurfaces old twomad cosplay photo
item.description: A viral post on X falsely claimed Belle Delphine was dead, stemming from an old collaboration photo with YouTuber twomad. While twomad passed away in February 2024, Belle Delphine remains alive and active on social media, with no news outlets reporting her death. The resurfaced images have led to misleading claims online.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta
